strings.Actividad física y retirada selectiva de: Physical activity and selective removal of accessible waste, with gloves, classification and final registration.
strings.Composición, paciencia y distancia: la i: Composition, patience and distance: the image never justifies disturbing an animal or stepping on a sensitive area.
strings.Comunicar sin masificar: contenido que e: Communicate without massifying: content that teaches, avoids sensitive geolocations and recognizes local entities.
strings.Crear observaciones educativas sobre esp: Create educational observations about species, waste, state of the environment and seasonal changes.
strings.Integrar mínimo impacto, plogging respon: Integrate minimal impact, responsible plogging, respect for trails and protection of sensitive locations.
strings.Jornada conceptual de observación colabo: Conceptual day of collaborative observation to record the greatest possible diversity without capturing or altering.
strings.La experiencia termina, pero el criterio: The experience ends, but the learned criteria can accompany each future outing.
strings.Leer costa, sierra, ramblas, viento, geo: Read coast, mountains, boulevards, wind, geology, posidonia, fauna and human landscape to understand where we are.
strings.Naturaleza Nómada | Aventura y educación: Nomadic Nature | Adventure and environmental education
strings.No basta con pasar sin dañar. La ambició: It is not enough to pass without damage. The ambition is to learn from the territory and help it retain its value.
strings.Pack educativo que combina aventura mode: Educational pack that combines moderate adventure, environmental reading, useful action and impact memory.
strings.Participantes por salida y ratio real: Participants by exit and actual ratio
strings.Peso y tipología, sin alterar residuos p: Weight and typology, without altering hazardous waste
strings.Recorrido respetuoso con flotación contr: Respectful tour with controlled flotation, basic identification and safe distance from fauna and sea beds.
strings.Senderismo suave para leer geología, sal: Gentle hiking to read geology, salinity, wind, flora and landscape transformation.
strings.Una versión operativa registraría indica: An operational version would record simple and auditable indicators. They are not current results, but rather the scorecard proposed for the project.
strings.Águilas, Calabardina, Cabo Cope, Sierra: Águilas, Calabardina, Cabo Cope, Sierra Almenara, ramblas, litoral mediterráneo, calas, acantilados, desierto costero y entornos cercanos.
strings.Familias, centros educativos, principian: Families, schools, beginners, people returning to sport, calm groups, photography lovers, wildlife observers and low-intensity experiences.
strings.La línea más accesible de Nómada Extremo: Nómada Extremo's most accessible line brings together sea, mountains, coastal desert and a leave-no-trace culture. It is for anyone who wants to learn, walk, observe, breathe and connect without needing extreme adrenaline.
strings.No busca exposición ni impacto emocional: It does not seek exposure or strong emotional impact. It seeks judgement, calm, environmental education, safety, terrain reading and respect for the group rhythm.
strings.Paseos interpretativos, lectura de paisa: Interpretive walks, landscape reading, common flora, wind, shade, water and simple orientation.
strings.Rutas interpretativas, senderismo consci: Interpretive routes, conscious hiking, nature bathing, respectful snorkelling, basic navigation, simple weather, photography and plogging.
strings.Senderos costeros, snorkel naturalista,: Senderos costeros, snorkel naturalista, fotografía, plogging y pequeñas acciones de mejora del entorno.
strings.Solo cuando sea legal, seguro y autoriza: Only when legal, safe and authorised. Planning, water, weather, equipment, waste, light and privacy of the environment.
